newsitem.title: UK: Labour's Blunkett says UK jobless data fiddled.
newsitem.headline: Labour's Blunkett says UK jobless data fiddled.

text.p: The opposition Labour Party's employment spokesman David Blunkett said on Wednesday that the latest unemployment figures had been fiddled.

"The Tories have changed the unemployment figures so many times that most people now completely discount them," Blunkett said as he issued a report detailing the changes which had been made to cut the number appearing on the unemployment register.

Saying there had been over 30 changes in all since 1979, Blunkett said: "Yet even these fiddled figures cannot hide the major facts. One in five non-pensioner households have nobody working in them. There is a gap of over 2.5 million between today's figures and the number of adults we know to be living in jobless households."
